notes.title: 🎉 Cybernetic Fault has officially exited Early Access!
notes.notes:
🎉 Cybernetic Fault has officially exited Early Access!
Dive into a world where science meets absurdity and become part of this unique adventure.
Don't miss the opportunity to experience a game that has already gained popularity among players!

-New levels and the story finale
-Updated interface
-Revised quests and dialogues
-Addition of new languages
-Numerous bug fixes

notes.notes:
Hi, friends! 
We've just uploaded a new update.

- Reworked game location  
- Added new quests  
- Changes to the combat system, including a new Rage mechanic  
- Dynamic music implemented  
- Replaced some models  
- Fixed several minor issues and bugs

notes.title: Depot/Installation Problems Fix
notes.notes:
Players are faced with the problem that the game does not install correctly. So far, we have included the previous working build in the depot, while we deal with the problems.
